claim_scope: Dependency-free atomic content-addressed receipt materialization and independent read-only offline verification from the real checkout CLI and exact credential-free public custody.
retained_invalid_attempts: The first expanded local evaluator read state-separated verifier errors from the outer command-error array rather than data.errors.
The first local mutation pass exposed a missing assertion that runtime-lock rejection occurs before materialization writes custody.
A direct base-interpreter meta-validator invocation lacked the intentionally evaluation-only jsonschema package; the governed exact-wheel evaluator passed.
The first wider local suite rejected the intentional additive receipt CLI against the prior topology implementation lock; prior locks were archived before reviewed rebinding.
The first public replay wrapper used an incorrect abbreviated candidate prefix and stopped before any clone or runtime action.
limitations: Receipt PASS authenticates only when the caller supplies the independently retained expected receipt digest.
This unit does not persist run events in PostgreSQL or prove interruption, backup, restore, dashboard, registry, redistribution, or release behavior.
No workflow manifest is approved or executed.

decision.reason: The exact public candidate reproduced atomic receipt custody, independent state-separated verification, runtime self-binding, all bounded mutations, clean-copy integrity, and unchanged authority/runtime custody without credentials.
